notes.title: Demo version available!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We're excited to announce that development on our visual novel "Yellow House" is in full swing.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3023880/Yellow_House/

We've been putting a lot of effort into crafting this story, and we're now ready to share the first result with you — a demo version that you can try out right now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3171600/
